reproductions.notes: NP2kai was built from commit 696c03b with -DBUILD_SDL=ON -DBUILD_X=OFF -DUSE_SDL2=ON -DBUILD_I286=OFF -DBUILD_HAXM=OFF. The game file was CO2-Pro (Flame Zapper Kotsujin).hdi, MD5 32d5b2337aae15dbcd39126ce35a339a, SHA1 8e92e7b6ff87c1e45cb586149634a93740317a09. The config expects the HDI at /home/tas2404/pc98roms/CO2-Pro (Flame Zapper Kotsujin).hdi and FONT.ROM at /home/tas2404/sdlnp21kai/FONT.ROM, so using the username tas2404 lets the submitted paths work unchanged. FONT.ROM MD5 was 38d32748ae49d1815b0614970849fd40. I also used the matching six 2608_*.WAV rhythm samples. I did not need the external PC-98 BIOS.ROM/ITF.ROM/etc. files to reproduce the run; NP2kai's fallback BIOS setup worked. [If using VirtualBox, keep the virtual optical drive empty while running NP2kai -- I encountered a crash in NP2kai's CD-ROM path while the Guest Additions ISO was mounted.]
